suppress.notes: io.opentelemetry.proto:opentelemetry-proto only carries the generated protobuf classes of the OTLP contract. The CPE opentelemetry:opentelemetry matches the Go, .NET, C++ and JavaScript SDKs (CVE-2026-39882, CVE-2026-40894, CVE-2026-41178, CVE-2026-44967, CVE-2026-54285), none of which is on the classpath.
